name: centry-residency-tracker
description:
Reconcile supplied travel ranges and workday records by person and country. Identify overlaps, missing days and missing source records; preserve citizenship, residence claims, domicile and family ties separately. Calendar arithmetic is not a tax residence decision.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Calendar evidence is not a statutory residence test or treaty conclusion. No passport OCR, booking-account access, location tracking or certificate. Only calendar ranges and supplied work records are reconciled. Country-specific residence tests, exceptions, deemed days, treaty rules and split years require specialists. Document links are user-selected references, not verification that the text supports supplied dates, countries or work hours. Document authenticity and completeness are unverified. No passport OCR, booking import or location tracking. Calendar dates are as entered; time zones, midnight location and transit need explicit evidence.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

Identify overlaps, missing days and missing source records; preserve citizenship, residence claims, domicile and family ties separately. Calendar arithmetic is not a tax residence decision.
